title: Imported Joomla copy doors include the webroot; a repeated question call gets a fresh answer form
steps: S1: verify a copy door that redirects, one with no container (ENOTFOUND), one answering a PHP fatal 500, one refusing the connection, a gateway 502, a slow one.
S2: verify a gated front door (HTML 200) and Joomla's guest JSON 403.
S3: list the copy doors of a Joomla import registered on its administrator door, on its front door, under a subfolder; of a WordPress import.
S4: the site agent reads COMPONENT_NOT_ON_FLEET_COPY with copyReason redirected, no_copy, copy_error.
S5: verify a Joomla copy installed at the root after importing a live subdirectory, preserving its query and copy origin.
S6: in Chrome render and answer two different questions, then a new call with the same second question; no empty pending state is delivered between calls.
expect: S1: redirected, no_copy, copy_error (not transient); unreachable, unreachable, timeout (transient).
S2: not_json and not_engine, both reasons to ask the copy's other door.
S3: registered door first, then the other door, subfolder kept; WordPress one door.
S4: each is said as what it is, with Do not retry and do not write another way.
S5: original pair first, then root pair; core.manifest verifies the root door. Root doors are deduplicated.

S6: each call opens a fresh form, starts without a selected answer, and delivers its own answer through dsh; a settled form never keeps the next call busy. This does not establish the cause of Bruce’s historical unanswered card.
evidence: Beta report 28/10/2026 1b (traumferien-azoren.de re-import, 25-26/10): every write refused as warming up for a day
fence: Fleet copy verification and door choice

tests: a copy that answers its plugin is verified
🔒 only a copy still starting is warming up: a refused connection, a gateway, a cut call
🔒 what waiting does not change says what it is: a redirect, no container, a server error
a door that answers without the plugin is the door, never a wrong token
the plugin itself refusing is the token, the CMS or its answer
🔒 a Joomla copy is asked on both its doors, the registered one first; the path under the webroot is kept
a WordPress copy, another component or a non-URL has its one door, or none
refusalNext: each door code names the next step — the customer, the call, or a repair — and never a way round
an imported Joomla in a live subdirectory can verify its copy at the webroot
root fallback keeps the registered administrator door first and deduplicates root doors
controller: a second call with identical questions reopens the form and clears the old answer
sequential questions: a different question and an identical new call each render and deliver a fresh answer
